entities.name: Maximino Ávila Camacho

entities.summary: Maximino Ávila Camacho was a Constitutionalist Army officer in the Mexican Revolution and afterwards politician who served as governor of Puebla from 1937 to 1941 and as secretary of public works in the cabinet of his brother, President Manuel Ávila Camacho.

entities.summary: Maximino Ávila Camacho was a Constitutionalist Army officer in the Mexican Revolution and afterwards politician who served as governor of Puebla from 1937 to 1941 and as secretary of public works in the cabinet of his brother, President Manuel Ávila Camacho.
